name: partitioned-frame
title: Partitioned 3-D space frame — OpenSeesMP-ready Tcl emit
teaches: A 2-storey x 2x2-bay rigid-jointed space frame partitioned into 4 ranks via Gmsh-native METIS, one rigid-floor diaphragm per storey (cross-partition replication, ADR 0027 INV-1/INV-2), and an OpenSeesMP-ready Tcl deck emitted via apeSees(fem).tcl(...) — no solver required to verify.
